text:
marta: Quick sync — before we publish the launch post + webinar landing, we need a canonical + routing plan to avoid splitting SEO and breaking analytics. Proposed plan below. Who's available for a quick 20?
eli: @marta yes. Main goals: preserve link equity, prevent parameterized URLs from being indexed, and keep CTA variants tracked.
rachel: also need messaging variants A/B for subject lines and landing hero copy. We want to route high-intent UTM to webinar signup flow (no detours).
andrew: can we do server-side canonical + strip UTM only for indexing? Keep UTMs for GA via a client-side capture? I can add server rule.
eli: Recommended checklist: canonical tag on page pointing to /launch, 301 canonicalization for true duplicates, meta robots noindex for preview/test pages, and use hreflang only if we have localized copies. For analytics, capture UTMs before we rewrite.
lucas: +1. For internal linking, make sure blog, docs, and nav point to the canonical URL (no tracking params). Use rel=canonical on AMP/alternate pages too.
marta: Action items (short): 1) Add canonical tag + test on staging. 2) Server rewrite to hide UTMs from crawlers but preserve them for analytics. 3) A/B experiment for hero copy + CTA. 4) 301s from legacy/old campaign URLs. Who picks each?
eli: I'll own canonical tag + staging tests (PR and Lighthouse check).
andrew: I'll add the rewrite rule and nginx snippet for staging. Example I plan to use:
```nginx
# strip common utm params for crawlers
if ($args ~* "utm_(source|medium|campaign|term|content)") {
  return 301 $scheme://$host$uri;
}
```
rachel: I'll own the copy variants and the experiment setup (VWO/Optimizely). Need final hero and CTA list by EOD so I can wire variants.
marta: tagging: @devex-bot can you run a quick indexability and robotx check after staging deploy? Post any 200 vs 301 mismatches here.
devex-bot: scheduled: index-check job queued for 3105552000. Will run crawl snapshot + robots test and post a link to the scan report here.
lucas: small note on redirects: use 301s for permanent canonical routes. For experiment previewing, 302 is fine but revert before measurement window closes. Also update sitemap.xml to point to canonical URLs only.
marta: timeline: staging tests today, go/no-go tomorrow AM, push before webinar email send. I'll make a checklist in the docs then ping engineering. Thanks all :rocket:
